descriptions.en: Chief toymaker of the Entrati, Father has embraced the holidays with a joyous fervor.

descriptions.en: A storyteller at heart, Grandmother’s holiday spirit has infested the whole family!

descriptions.en: Unfortunately, the Island of Misfit Cephalons was full this cycle.

descriptions.en: All through the Drift, not a creature was stirring, not even a Predasite.

descriptions.en: Not Queens. Not Vay Hek. Only Tenno and Blue Girl celebrate TennoBaum with Kahl.
